LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Non- fiction: Introduction - Features of non-fiction - Categories of non-fiction, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Non- fiction: Introduction - Features of non-fiction - Categories of non-fiction.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Non- fiction: Introduction - Features of non-fiction - Categories of non-fiction.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Non- fiction: Introduction - Features of non-fiction - Categories of non-fiction.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Non- fiction: Introduction - Features of non-fiction - Categories of non-fiction.

2. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. run
   C. blue
   D. quickly

3. When practising Poetry 2.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry Types of poems: - Free verse - Blank verse -, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use insults to “practise” Poetry 2.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry Types of poems: - Free verse - Blank verse -.

4. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. where is the library

13. In three clear sentences, explain Non- Fiction: Personal Journal -Language and style and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Literature 4.1.1 Short Forms of Oral Literature - Types - Features - Functi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Poetry 4.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry Language and Style: - Onomatopoeia - Idiopho and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fiction and Non- fiction 4.3.1 Fiction: The Play from Kenya - Structure - Featur and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Non- fiction: Introduction - Features of non-fiction - Categories of non-fiction.

2. B — run

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Poetry 2.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry Types of poems: - Free verse - Blank verse -.

4. D — Where is the library?

7. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fiction and Non- Fiction 1.3.2 Non- fiction: Introduction - Features of non-fict.

8. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fiction: Novel from Kenya - Characters - Characterisation - Point of view - Lang.

9. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fiction: Novel from Kenya - Features of prose fiction - The Author - The plot - .

10. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fiction and Non - Fiction 2.3.1 Fiction: Novel from Kenya - Characters - Charact.

11. D — A person, place, thing, or idea

12. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fiction and Non- Fiction 1.3.1 Fiction: Novel from Kenya - Features of prose fic.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Non- Fiction: Personal Journal -Language and style; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Oral Literature 4.1.1 Short Forms of Oral Literature - Types - Features - Functi; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Poetry 4.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry Language and Style: - Onomatopoeia - Idiopho; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Fiction and Non- fiction 4.3.1 Fiction: The Play from Kenya - Structure - Featur; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
